shared.difficulty_note: Proposed planet difficulty index, independent of size/element; absent from current data. D0 calibration assigns 1 to every type.
shared.xp_storage: OwnedCreature.Exp is cumulative integer XP, derived level from approved T(L); cap at T(100), no bank
shared.migration: One-time versioned conversion with backup; never reapply to saves already storing cumulative level XP
shared.capture_initial_xp: T(encounter_level); preserve wild form and level; no victim growth XP; captured creature joins the eligible roster only in the lobby
shared.reward_eligibility: Snapshot roster before event; approved per-event appeared/dead records; dead sidekicks receive 0 too; unique instance IDs across mains and sidekicks; one main per sidekick
shared.issuance: E is the main-only pool; sidekick XP is additional issuance and never deducted from E
shared.sidekick_basis: Main actual XP means integer growth XP credited AFTER rounding and LV100 clipping
shared.quest_rewards: Once per genuinely completed step and once per chain with all 5 genuinely completed steps; boss auto-skip grants no XP for skipped steps and no chain bonus
shared.event_identity: One normal/elite/boss payout per defeated spawn; one capture payout on success only; capture can add to defeat XP; retries/replayed settlement must not pay twice
shared.rounding_tie_break: Largest remainder ties use ascending persistent instance ID, not party order; no fractional carry between events
shared.arithmetic: Non-negative integer/Fraction only; source event E <= Int32.MaxValue; aggregate ledgers and intermediate products use Int64 or wider; cap by available headroom before addition

A.label: Recommended: level-scaled, conserved main pool, bounded sidekick group
A.formula: E = floor(base[source] * C(min(L,99)) * role_multiplier / C(10)); C from progression.json; no stage multiplier
A.source_level: Defeat/capture: original encounter level; quest step: normal wild level of objective region; chain: boss encounter level
A.migration_formula: Exp_new = T(stage_floor); old Exp is backed up, not interpreted as cumulative growth XP
A.sidekick_formula: Group budget = floor(main_actual/2); split equally among living linked sidekicks including LV100, using largest remainder; capped shares discarded
A.losses: All-dead pool E; capped main assigned XP/overflow; 1/2 XP per odd main actual when a living sidekick group exists; capped sidekick assigned XP/overflow. No other rounding loss.
A.tradeoff: Stable team budget and at most 50% extra issuance; capped slots waste shares and higher-level gates require more runs.

B.label: Alternative: stage-scaled, individual half shares, faster collection
B.formula: E = floor(base[source] * stage_multiplier * (difficulty+1) * role_multiplier / 2); boss also adds floor(base[wild] * stage_multiplier * (difficulty+1) / 2)
B.source_stage: Defeat/capture: actual form stage; quest step: objective region tier; chain: adult (2). No enemy-level factor.
B.migration_formula: Exp_new = min(T(100), T(stage_floor) + old_Exp); legacy XP treated as bonus, not already cumulative
B.sidekick_formula: Each living linked sidekick gets floor(main_actual/2); capped sidekick discards its own share; no redistribution or recursive rewards
B.losses: All-dead/all-capped pool E; sum of each main fractional remainder; main overflow when reaching cap mid-event; 1/2 XP per odd main actual per living sidekick; capped sidekick assigned XP/overflow.
B.tradeoff: Quick growth and no max-level main sink, but more sidekicks mint more XP and adult captures can bypass early gates.

d0_evidence.quest_element_match_probability: For a represented biased element: 3/(7+2*b), b = number of represented biased elements; verdant b=3 => 3/13, three matches take 13 normal victims in expectation. Twilight light/shadow are absent from nonstarter pool, so its defeat-wild step cannot match; boss still ends run.
d0_evidence.count_caveat: Spawn inventory is not a mandatory kill count; plan seed and route vary. No telemetry/time-to-kill claim. Calibration is a representative quest route on verdant, not a replay of an observed play session.

pacing_target.reason: Several capture/switching loops before the juvenile evolution gate; material requirements remain separate. Solo starter pacing is faster and must be reviewed separately.

d0_run_model.name: verdant_quest_route
d0_run_model.capture_note: Fixed representative outcomes (2/4 + guaranteed boss), not rounded probabilistic expectation; assumes capture step succeeds before boss.
d0_run_model.sidekick_note: Sensitivity fixture only; current D0 has no sidekick loadout. This is not a proposal for a slot limit.
d0_run_model.repeat_policy: Repeat fixed difficulty and event mix; growth retained for pacing projection, all roster entries start at LV10, captured creatures go to storage, no automatic evolution; independent event records mark the same two participants afresh.
